items.source: You may combine the ExceptionHandler annotation with @ResponseStatus for a specific HTTP error status.
items.translation: 您可以将 `ExceptionHandler` 注解与针对特定 HTTP 错误状态的 @ResponseStatus 组合使用。

items.source: This is an alias for exception().
items.translation: 这是exception()的别名。

items.source:
Handler methods which are annotated with this annotation are allowed to
have very flexible signatures. They may have parameters of the following
types, in arbitrary order:
items.translation: 带有此注解的处理器方法可以具有非常灵活的签名。它们可以按任意顺序具有以下类型的参数：

items.source: The following return types are supported for handler methods:
items.translation: 以下返回类型支持用于处理器方法：

items.source: Exceptions handled by the annotated method.
items.translation: 由注解方法处理的异常。

items.source: Media Types that can be produced by the annotated method.
items.translation: 由注解方法可生成的媒体类型。

items.source: Session object: typically HttpSession. An argument of this type will enforce the presence of a corresponding session. As a consequence, such an argument will never be null. Note that session access may not be thread-safe, in particular in a Servlet environment: Consider switching the "synchronizeOnSession" flag to "true" if multiple requests are allowed to access a session concurrently.
items.translation: Session 对象：通常为 HttpSession。 此类型的参数将强制存在相应的会话。 因此，此类参数永远不会为 null。 请注意，会话访问可能不是线程安全的，特别是在 Servlet 环境中：如果允许多个请求并发访问会话，请考虑将"synchronizeOnSession"标志切换为 "true"。

items.source: HttpEntity<?> or ResponseEntity<?> object (Servlet-only) to set response headers and content. The ResponseEntity body will be converted and written to the response stream using message converters.
items.translation: HttpEntity<?> 或 ResponseEntity<?> 对象（仅限 Servlet）用于设置响应头和内容。ResponseEntity 的主体将使用 消息转换器 进行转换并写入响应流。

items.source: void if the method handles the response itself (by writing the response content directly, declaring an argument of type ServletResponse / HttpServletResponse for that purpose) or if the view name is supposed to be implicitly determined through a RequestToViewNameTranslator (not declaring a response argument in the handler method signature).
items.translation: void，如果该方法自行处理响应（通过直接写入响应内容，或为此声明类型为 ServletResponse / HttpServletResponse 的参数），或者视图名称应通过 RequestToViewNameTranslator 隐式确定（不在处理器方法签名中声明响应参数）。

items.source: WebRequest or NativeWebRequest. Allows for generic request parameter access as well as request/session attribute access, without ties to the native Servlet API.
items.translation: WebRequest 或 NativeWebRequest。 支持通用的请求参数访问以及请求/会话属性访问，无需依赖原生 Servlet API。

items.source: Locale for the current request locale (determined by the most specific locale resolver available, i.e. the configured LocaleResolver in a Servlet environment).
items.translation: Locale 用于当前请求的区域设置（由可用的最具体的区域设置解析器确定，即在 Servlet 环境中配置的 LocaleResolver）。

items.source: InputStream / Reader for access to the request's content. This will be the raw InputStream/Reader as exposed by the Servlet API.
items.translation: InputStream / Reader 以访问请求的内容。这将是 Servlet API 暴露的原始 InputStream/Reader。

items.source: OutputStream / Writer for generating the response's content. This will be the raw OutputStream/Writer as exposed by the Servlet API.
items.translation: OutputStream / Writer 用于生成响应的内容。这将是 Servlet API 暴露的原始 OutputStream/Writer。

items.source: Model object, with the view name implicitly determined through a RequestToViewNameTranslator.
items.translation: `Model` 对象，其视图名称通过 `RequestToViewNameTranslator` 接口隐式确定。

items.source: Map object for exposing a model, with the view name implicitly determined through a RequestToViewNameTranslator.
items.translation: 用于暴露模型的 `Map` 对象，其视图名称通过一个 RequestToViewNameTranslator 隐式确定。

items.source: ProblemDetail or ErrorResponse object to render an RFC 9457 error response with details in the body.
items.translation: ProblemDetail 或 ErrorResponse对象用于渲染包含详细信息的 RFC 9457 错误响应。

items.source: @ResponseBody annotated methods (Servlet-only) to set the response content. The return value will be converted to the response stream using message converters.
items.translation: @ResponseBody 注解的方法（仅限 Servlet）用于设置响应内容。返回值将使用 消息转换器 转换为响应流。

items.source: An exception argument: declared as a general Exception or as a more specific exception. This also serves as a mapping hint if the annotation itself does not narrow the exception types through its value(). You may refer to a top-level exception being propagated or to a nested cause within a wrapper exception. Any cause level is exposed.
items.translation: 异常参数：声明为通用的 Exception 或更具体的异常。如果该注解本身未通过其 value() 收窄异常类型，这也作为映射提示。您可以引用被传播的顶层异常，或包装异常内的嵌套原因。任何原因层级均会被暴露。

items.source: Request and/or response objects (typically from the Servlet API). You may choose any specific request/response type, for example, ServletRequest / HttpServletRequest.
items.translation: 请求和/或响应对象（通常来自 Servlet API）。您可以选择任何特定的请求/响应类型，例如，`ServletRequest` / `HttpServletRequest`。

items.source: Model as an alternative to returning a model map from the handler method. Note that the provided model is not pre-populated with regular model attributes and therefore always empty, as a convenience for preparing the model for an exception-specific view.
items.translation: Model 作为从处理程序方法返回模型映射的替代方案。请注意，提供的模型未预填充常规模型属性，因此始终为空，这为准备特定于异常的视图提供了便利。

items.source: String value which is interpreted as view name.
items.translation: String 值，该值被解释为视图名称。

items.source: ModelAndView object (from Servlet MVC).
items.translation: ModelAndView 对象（来自 Servlet MVC）。

items.source:
Exceptions handled by the annotated method. If empty, will default to any
exceptions listed in the method argument list.
items.translation: 由注解方法处理的异常。如果为空，则默认为方法参数列表中列出的任何异常。

items.source: Arjen Poutsma, Juergen Hoeller, Brian Clozel
items.translation: Arjen Poutsma, Juergen Hoeller, Brian Clozel
